newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not established on a live basis, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said. Demand was light and seller interest light.
